methodology_lineage.statement: Product 90 publishes LDEM_*_ADJ_ERR.TIF as LDEM surface height error in meters and cites Barker et al. 2023 for the product methodology.
Barker et al. 2023 produced the improved large-area south-polar LDEMs and associated uncertainty estimates over multiple pixel scales.

methodology_lineage.reference: Barker et al. 2025, The Planetary Science Journal 6:83
methodology_lineage.statement: The follow-on polar-method paper states that gridded LDEM height/slope uncertainty maps represent RMS uncertainty relative to true average pixel height/slope using uncertainty-versus-effective-resolution relations derived by Barker et al. 2023, and reports the corresponding South-Pole uncertainty behavior.

non_claims: This policy classifies source uncertainty semantics; it does not choose a tail distribution, covariance model, confidence level or familywise risk budget.
RMS uncertainty is not a deterministic terrain displacement bound.
Spatial-support completeness remains an independent LL-009R obligation.
